title: The Truth Within the Fragment
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji fell into shock, the protective Jade Pendant worn close to Su Qingyao's body suddenly burst forth with dazzling white light, revealing an ancient line of text identical to that on the fragment—a warning only Chen Ji could comprehend.

text.content:
It felt as if something in the depths of his Mental Sea had been violently torn open. Chen Ji sensed his consciousness being dragged into an abyss by a force of overwhelming magnitude. Su Qingyao's anxious cry—'Chen Ji! What's wrong!'—reached his ears like a distant echo across countless mountains and rivers.

That force was cold and solemn, utterly devoid of emotion, yet permeated with a suffocating pressure. He wanted to struggle, but found every limb and bone seemingly locked in place, unable to move.

Darkness.

Endless darkness surged toward him, or perhaps he was falling into endless darkness. Time became meaningless—whether a fleeting instant or countless eons—before Chen Ji finally stabilized his consciousness within that void.

He looked down at his hands, only to find them semi-transparent, as if his soul had departed from his body. Countless points of light floated around him, like shattered fragments of stars slowly converging toward him.

dialogue.content: (Smirking internally) Same old trick. Nothing changes, just a higher-dimensional illusion. Trying to intimidate me with fear? Hmph.

text.content:
Those points of light suddenly accelerated, flooding into his Brow Center. In an instant, the Tianji Record fragment seemed forcibly reassembled by some power—Chen Ji saw—he saw the entire process of his body's birth from nothingness!

A vague silhouette stood within the chaos, surrounded by enigmatic runes. It had no face, yet seemed to smile. That smile held no kindness—only the indifferent detachment of one surveying chess pieces.

"No..." Chen Ji wanted to retreat, but that vague silhouette was already inches away. An information stream flooded directly into his Mental Sea—

The Ultimate Chessmaster was not born into existence.

It was born at the universe's inception, a fragment of the first consciousness within chaos. It treats all realms as chessboards, sentient beings as pieces, weaving games spanning infinite spacetime.

dialogue.content: (Echoing within Chen Ji's Mental Sea) I observe the rise and fall of worlds, civilizations flourishing and perishing like fleeting illusions. Mortal creatures are merely dust beneath my hand. You are but a slightly larger grain of dust.

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a剧烈的眩晕 as another scene forcibly invaded his consciousness—scenery he had never witnessed: a majestic temple suspended within a sea of stars, and at its center, a massive eye was enshrined. That eye was pitch-black throughout, yet its pupil was brilliant gold, radiating a terrifying pressure.

The Eye of Heavenly Way.

Yet now Chen Ji finally saw the truth—that so-called Eye of Heavenly Way was merely a tool used by the Ultimate Chessmaster to harvest human fortune, a puppet hand extended into this world!

(Forcibly suppressing surging emotions, rapidly calculating in his heart) So that's how it is. No wonder Master Mo always seemed欲言又止, no wonder the Tianji Record's information is incomplete—this is not some fortunate opportunity at all, it's a meticulously forged shackle!

New scenes invaded once more. This time, Chen Ji saw his own past—or rather, the 'manufacturing process' of this body.

The Ultimate Chessmaster began selecting vessels ten thousand years ago. Using the Tianji Record as bait and Heavenly Fate Values as the lure, it sifted through countless mortals to find a body capable of bearing its will.

dialogue.content: (The vague silhouette's voice) Ten thousand years of selection, a hundred lifetimes of searching. Your bloodline, your bone structure, your experiences—all criteria for becoming a vessel. I intended to harvest everything when you reached the pinnacle—including your very soul.

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a chill of revulsion crawl from his spine to the crown of his head. He recalled all the 'coincidences' in his life—why did the Tianji Record specifically choose him? Were those seemingly accidental opportunities actually pieces already positioned on the board?

Even his own existence was merely a scheme laid down ten thousand years ago by the Ultimate Chessmaster!

His pride in his meticulous calculations, his carefully cultivated废物 persona—before this true eternal chess game, all seemed so laughably insignificant.

choice.prompt: The truth exploded like thunder, Chen Ji's consciousness violently trembling within his Mental Sea. The Ultimate Chessmaster's pressure pressed down like mountains, but his nature would never allow easy surrender. At this moment, he must make a choice:

choices.text: Accept the truth, conceal strength and await opportunity
choices.description: Since I am already a piece, I shall turn the tables. On the surface, follow the Tianji Record's guidance; secretly, seek weaknesses. Use the million-year chess game as the board, and counterattack the Ultimate Chessmaster.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate Values to stabilize the Mental Sea
choices.risk_hint: If detected by the Eye of Heavenly Way, Heavenly Fate backlash will be triggered

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his anger gradually收敛, replaced by a near-mad calmness. (Smirking internally) What a magnificent eternal chess game. Since you want me as a piece, I shall become one you can never control.

He proactively released control of his Mental Sea, allowing the fragment's information to continue flooding in. Simultaneously, he secretly inscribed a hidden mark in the depths of his consciousness—a microscopic flaw within the original Tianji Record structure, intending to use it to counterattack this very shackle.

choices.text: Defy fate, never surrender to destiny
choices.description: Whatever eternal chess game you impose, I Chen Ji never believed in destiny! Forcefully shatter the Mental Sea seal, use Heavenly Fate Values to clash against the Ultimate Chessmaster's pressure—even if crushed to dust, tear apart this shackle!
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 Heavenly Fate Values to forcefully break through
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji Record cracks, releasing partial primordial power
choices.risk_hint: When Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero, it will cause soul scatter and spirit dissipate

text.content:
An unprecedented sharp light burst from Chen Ji's eyes. He had never bowed to anyone, so how could he submit to a nebulous 'Ultimate Chess Player'?

'My fate is in my own hands, not in heaven's!'

He madly burned his Heavenly Fate Value, using his Mental Sea as the battlefield, engaging in a desperate fight against that vast and oppressive force. Agonizing pain came from the depths of his soul, but gritting his teeth, he managed to tear a tiny crack in those shackles!

choices.text: Using the shackles, reverse the harvest
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record is a shackle, turn it into a weapon. Using the information loopholes planted by the Ultimate Chess Player, construct puppet imprints in reverse within the Mental Sea, attempting to steal control of the shackles.
choices.visible_cost: Must maintain extreme focus, mistakes will lead to consciousness collapse
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily gain partial authority over the complete version of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the vigilance mechanism of the Ultimate Chess Player

text.content:
A cunning glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The Ultimate Chess Player wanted to harvest him, so he would do the opposite—settle this account before the other party could harvest!

He began to carefully analyze the structure embedded within the Tianji Record Fragment, searching for those deliberately hidden information loopholes.

He actually found them. To control the holder of the Tianji Record, the Ultimate Chess Player had buried numerous recessive control nodes within the fragment. But conflicts existed between these nodes—it was precisely these conflicts that gave Chen Ji an opportunity.

Just as Chen Ji was engaged in a difficult game of wits with that shackle in his Mental Sea, outside—in the secret chamber of the Tianqing Sect—Su Qingyao was watching the suddenly rigid Chen Ji with anxious eyes.

Strange golden patterns emerged on the surface of his body, those patterns moving like living creatures beneath his skin. Su Qingyao tried to wake him, only to find herself unable to approach—an invisible barrier blocked her.

Within the Mental Sea, Chen Ji was undergoing an unprecedented trial. That fuzzy silhouette seemed to sense his unusual movements, the oppressive pressure suddenly multiplying several times over.

'A mere ant's body, yet dares to peer into true knowledge?' A hint of anger entered that voice.

Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea beginning to violently tremble, as if on the verge of collapse. He knew he had to make a decision quickly.

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chess Player's oppressive pressure grew stronger and stronger, and cracks had already appeared in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. At this moment of life and death, he had to make his final choice:

choices.description: A true man knows when to bend and when to stand tall. Currently the power gap is vast, so for now submit and wait for another day. As long as one lives, there will be opportunities for a comeback.
choices.visible_reward: Gain temporary shelter from the Ultimate Chess Player
choices.risk_hint: May gradually be assimilated into a puppet

text.content:
Chen Ji forced down the humiliation in his heart and slowly lowered his head. That fuzzy silhouette let out a sound that was half-laugh and half-scorn, and the oppressive pressure immediately lessened.

'The wise know when to yield. You, after all, are smarter than those ants.'

choices.text: Let the fish die and the net be torn apart, jade and stone alike shall perish
choices.description: I, Chen Ji, have traversed two lifetimes and never bowed to anyone! Even the Ultimate Chess Player, if it wants my life, must break a few teeth! Burn all Heavenly Fate Value and perish together with these shackles!
choices.visible_cost: May permanently lose the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Shackles shatter, gain true free will
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, may result in mutual destruction

text.content:
Chen Ji let out a roar, detonating all his Heavenly Fate Value! A breathtaking brilliance erupted within the Mental Sea, and that fuzzy silhouette was actually forced back a step!

'You...' For the first time, that voice carried surprise.

At the moment Chen Ji made his choice—

Outside, in a secret chamber of the Tianqing Sect, the protective Jade Pendant that Su Qingyao carried close to her body suddenly burst forth with dazzling white light! The light was like a sword, directly piercing through the invisible barrier that separated her!

On the surface of the Jade Pendant, an ancient line of text slowly emerged. The text was extremely mysterious, yet it was exactly the same as the fragment text in Chen Ji's Mental Sea!

dialogue.content: (Gripping the Jade Pendant tightly, voice trembling) Chen Ji! Can you hear me? The words on this Jade Pendant... what do they mean!

text.content:
The meaning of that line of text, Chen Ji saw clearly within his Mental Sea—

「The Chess Player is not the only one, the shackles have cracks. You are neither a lonely child nor an abandoned child. The method to break the situation lies in—」

The text abruptly stopped, as if forcibly severed by some force. But the final incomplete symbol left Chen Ji with a strange sense of familiarity...

dialogue.content: (In the Mental Sea, Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes) This symbol... it's Chen Nian! This is the signal I taught her! Could... could she still be alive?!

text.content:
In the depths of the Mental Sea, that blurred silhouette also seemed to sense the anomaly. It let out a low murmur, then slowly dissipated.

Chen Ji felt that overwhelming pressure retreating, yet his heart was churning with turbulent waves.

Chen Nian—his sister who had been missing for years—was actually connected to all of this by intricate threads!

What was this message she left trying to tell him?
